1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein __said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME®__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __and wherein the incubation is performed at a temperature between 37-50°C__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using magnetic particles__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to separate the DNA-bound particles__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that are less than 14 days after pollination__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent condition at 4°C__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed using Taqman PCR__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __wherein the genotyping is performed without prior whole genome amplification__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __for at least one trait selected from the group consisting of disease resistance, herbicide tolerance, and yield__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __using multiple displacement amplification__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selection is based on the presence of at least two different genetic markers__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __within 48 hours of selection__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic liquid handling systems__.
